title.zh: 特朗普计划借白宫网络犯罪活动，展示打击境外加密诈骗成果
title.en: 特朗普计划借白宫网络犯罪活动，展示打击境外加密诈骗成果

current_state.zh: The Trump administration used a White House cybercrime event to highlight US enforcement against overseas crypto scam operations, including the seizure of about $833 million in crypto assets, the takedown of 503 fraudulent websites, and notifications to nearly 9,000 Americans.
